newsitem.title: USA: Quick/Reilly declines comment on deal talk.
newsitem.headline: Quick/Reilly declines comment on deal talk.

text.p: Major discount broker Quick & Reilly Group Inc Tuesday declined comment on press reports about a possible sale of the company.
"As a matter of policy, we do not comment on rumors or speculation about Quick & Reilly's involvement in mergers and acquisitions," the company said in a prepared statement.

"We feel we are strategically positioned for growth. We have the right strategy in place to continue to build upon one of the brokerage industry's most outstanding performance records. We are committed to continuing to build shareholder value, and see many opportunities to do so on our own," the company said in its statement.
Quick & Reilly's stock surged 2-3/16 to 31-1/2 on the rumors.

Rumors had been circulating recently about further consolidation in the brokerage industry but speculation has centered on full-service firms such as Salomon Inc and Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc, rather than the discount brokerages.
